Data: CelesTrak SATCAT, downloaded September 23, 2026. One row is one cataloged object. Launch year is the year in the launch date column, except that the 416 payloads released from the International Space Station, which carry the station's 1998 launch date, are placed in the year they entered the catalog. Still in orbit means no decay date. Active payloads have operational status +, P, B, S or X. Perigee and inclination come from the latest cataloged orbit and are left out of medians where the catalog has none. Years in orbit run from the launch date to the decay date, or to September 23, 2026 for objects still up. On the globe, orbital planes and positions along each orbit are assigned at random, since the catalog does not record them.
